decisions.briefing: Stocks rose today, led by tech: the NASDAQ gained 1.5% and the S&P 500 gained 0.7%. Cash is only $345.88, which is under the $500 minimum for a new buy, so I bought nothing even though 3 slots are open. Past results say small buys forced on moderate up-days don't help. The 7 current positions stay as they are, and their automatic stop-losses and profit targets keep running.

market_education.summary_en: Markets rose today and tech led the way: the NASDAQ gained 1.5% while the S&P 500 added 0.7%, a sign investors were willing to take on more risk. Our screener showed many speculative, high-momentum stocks lining up at once, including quantum computing (IONQ, RGTI, QBTS), bitcoin miners (RIOT, HUT, IREN) and nuclear energy (OKLO, LEU, SMR), all with bullish MACD signals. No news headlines came in with today's data, so we can't say for sure what caused the move, and we cite no sources rather than guess.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市造好，科技股領漲，納斯達克指數升1.5%，標普500指數升0.7%，反映投資者風險胃納回升。從篩選結果可見，資金明顯湧向高動能的投機板塊：量子運算（IONQ、RGTI、QBTS）、比特幣礦企（RIOT、HUT、IREN）以及核能股（OKLO、LEU、SMR）同步出現MACD黃金交叉等多項看漲訊號。由於今日數據未附帶相關新聞標題，未能確定觸發升市的具體消息，故不引述任何來源，以免臆測。

daily_lesson.term: Fully Invested (Cash Drag vs. Dry Powder)
daily_lesson.explanation_en: A portfolio is 'fully invested' when almost all its money is already in stocks and only a little cash is left. That's why we couldn't add new positions on an up day like today. Holding a lot of cash creates 'cash drag', because idle money earns nothing while the market rises. Keeping some 'dry powder' (spare cash) does have a benefit, though: it lets you buy good opportunities when they show up.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 所謂「全倉投資」（Fully Invested），是指組合中絕大部分資金已投入股票，手頭只剩少量現金，因此即使今日大市向好，也無法再開新倉。持有過多現金會造成「現金拖累」（Cash Drag），即升市時閒置資金未能參與升幅；但保留適量「彈藥」（Dry Powder）亦有好處，讓投資者在優質機會出現時能及時入市。
